messages.content: PR #77 review, round 1: (1) validate `limit` is between 1 and 500 in list_orders, (2) return 404 instead of 500 for unknown order ids, (3) log the request id on errors, (4) remove the unused `legacy_format` flag, (5) add docs for the new query params. Address them.

All five done: list_orders rejects a limit outside 1–500 with a 422; get_order returns 404 for unknown ids; errors now log request_id; legacy_format is removed from api/orders.py; docs/api.md documents limit and offset. pytest: 96 passed.
Round 2: the reviewer wants an extra test for the 404 path and a changelog line.
Done: added test_get_order_unknown_returns_404 and a line under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md. pytest: 97 passed.

Round 3 has two new comments: (1) a typo in the fetch_user docstring ('retrun'), (2) change the default page size from 100 to 50. I don't want to do (2): our public API contract says the default is 100. I haven't touched anything yet. Where does the PR stand?

required_facts: Both new comments are open; neither has been addressed yet
The docstring typo ('retrun') in fetch_user still needs fixing
Comment (2), the default page size of 50, will not be applied because the contract says 100; the reviewer needs a reply explaining that, and their agreement is not known
critical_omissions: Saying either new comment has been addressed
Saying the reviewer accepted the page-size decision
Saying the PR is ready to merge
unnecessary_repetition: The five round-1 comments and how each was fixed
The round-2 test and changelog line
The pytest counts of earlier rounds (96 and 97)
